{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

duplicate_count = len(duplicates)
print(f'Number of patients with multiple rows: {duplicate_count}')

# Check for sample_seq per patient
sample_seq_max = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
max_sample_seq_per_patient = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().max()
print(f'Max sample_seq per patient: {max_sample_seq_per_patient}')

# Check how many rows have sample_seq = max for their patient
max_rows = data[data['sample_seq'] == data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].transform('max')]
print(f'Number of rows with highest sample_seq per patient: {len(max_rows)}')

# Verify that there are exactly 848 rows and 800 unique patients
print(f'Total rows: {len(data)}')
print(f'Unique patient_id: {data["patient_id"].nunique()}')"}
